name: Mandarin Chinese vocabulary

roles.Prompt: Chinese headword using the script selected by profile_options.script; preserve the source script when that option is 'source'.
roles.Answer: Concise common English meaning or meanings.
roles.Notes: Hanyu Pinyin using profile_options.pinyin_style, plus classifier or usage notes when essential.
roles.Example:
A complete natural Chinese sentence, then
, then a complete English translation.

rules: Do not mix simplified and traditional forms unless Notes explicitly labels both.
Preserve tone marks or tone numbers consistently within a batch.
Record a classifier only when it is useful for normal use of a noun.
Separate genuinely different meanings with semicolons and avoid redundant synonyms.
Prefer a source example; enrich from a reputable dictionary only when missing; generate only as a last resort.
